articles.summary: This month's theme is governance. We introduced data classification as first-class metadata on every workspace — declared at provision time, color-coded in the UI, and pushed into your Terraform runs as cloud tags and labels. Alongside it: organization-owned API keys built to outlive personnel changes, and richer cloud-specific tagging on ns_workspace. We also shipped nullstone apps release to take infra and app code live in one command, made variable and secret editing far nicer in the UI, and added a GCP BigQuery + Datastream data-pipeline set to the catalog. Read on for details.
articles.title: Changelog: July 2026
